steps.text: A battery is two or more cells joined together. Let's build one and see what changes.
Add more cells and connect them so the + of one meets the − of the next.
Joined + to −, the cells add up, so the battery pushes more strongly and the bulb glows brighter.
That's why torches and toys use two or three cells — connecting cells the right way (+ to −) makes a stronger battery.

coach.mission: Connect cells into a battery and see the effect.
whenStuck: Add cells and line them up + to −.
Watch how the brightness changes as you add cells.
whenWrong: Cells add up only when joined + to − in a line.
More cells connected correctly means more power and a brighter bulb.
whenCorrect: Right — cells joined + to − add up into a battery.
coach.done: You've built a battery from cells. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
